params.name: cursor
params.description: `cursor` is the opaque string from a previous response's `next_cursor`. Omit on the first request; pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page.

params.name: filter
params.description:
`filter` narrows which traces are returned for this thread, using a LangSmith filter expression evaluated against each root trace run.
For example: eq(status, "success") or has(tags, "production").
See https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/trace-query-syntax#filter-query-language for syntax.

params.name: page_size
params.description: `page_size` is the maximum number of traces to return in this response. Defaults to 20 when omitted; must be between 1 and 100 inclusive when set.

params.name: selects
params.description: `selects` lists which properties to include on each returned trace (repeatable query parameter). Accepts any value of the `ThreadTraceSelectField` enum. Properties not listed are omitted from each trace object; `trace_id` is always returned.
